order.note: Thermal is taught as machine-first: a redstone furnace and a pulverizer before any power planning, because both run on a small dynamo.
Stirling dynamo is the entry generator - it burns solid fuel and needs no infrastructure.

tiers.note: Thermal tiers by AUGMENT rather than by rebuilding machines: the same pulverizer is upgraded in place. This is the mod's structural difference from Mekanism's basic/advanced/elite/ultimate rebuild ladder.
Dynamo family is chosen by available fuel rather than by tier - stirling for solids, magmatic for lava, compression for fuel, plus niche gourmand/lapidary/numismatic/disenchantment variants.
Machine roster expands sideways into processing specialities rather than upward.

signature.note: The pulverizer plus redstone furnace pair is the classic Thermal opening and what the mod is remembered for.
Fluxduct/itemduct logistics and the flux capacitor are Thermal's other identity pieces.

human_notes.confidence: LOW. See the report - Thermal is the weakest mod in this batch. Its ids are prefix-ordered (machine_pulverizer) while speech is natural-order ('the pulverizer'), it ships NO lang file for the expansion machines, and the best available video series is Foundation/Cultivation-heavy rather than machine-heavy. Counts here are thin and the ladder above is inferred from limited corroboration.
